question: Should head 5951a7d0c384df6c0395a6ebd087e60d2e3023b0 enter a bounded repair canary now, or remain draft until additional live mutation-boundary evidence is captured?
rationale: Tests and repeated exact-head reviews support correctness, but only maintainers can authorize rollout of a new fail-closed contract governing live GitHub mutations and state publication.

options.title: Run bounded canary
options.body: Exercise one controlled stale-drift rejection and one unchanged authorized mutation path, inspect receipts and state publication, then merge if both behave as designed.

options.title: Merge with monitoring
options.body: Accept the remaining production-only uncertainty and merge the reviewed head with immediate monitoring for blocked repair clusters and publication failures.

options.title: Keep draft
options.body: Leave the PR open until broader live or Crabbox evidence demonstrates the authorization and credential-renewal paths.
